title: rosa micrantha subvar. plicata
intro: Rosa micrantha subvar. plicata, commonly known as Rosa micrantha var. plicata, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae, known for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Rosa micrantha var. plicata include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, reducing muscle spasms and cramps, and its antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
